public_payload.normalized_proposition: If verified-yet-anonymous proof-of-human is required for high-reach interactions, it will make it mathematically difficult and financially ruinous for one operator to secretly run ten thousand accounts.
conditions: this kind of proof-of-human is required for high-reach interactions

statement.excerpt: If we require this kind of “proof-of-human” for high-reach interactions, we make it mathematically difficult and financially ruinous for one operator to secretly run ten thousand accounts.
statement.document_title: AI bot swarms threaten to undermine democracy

our_interpretation: The antecedent requires enforced, privacy-preserving unique-human credentials for high-reach interactions. Optional verification badges do not satisfy it.
The consequence concerns operating 10,000 qualifying accounts under one operator's covert control, including acquired or borrowed credentials.

‘Mathematically difficult’ means that the implemented security guarantees materially constrain duplication; ‘financially ruinous’ means prohibitive total operating costs. Neither has a supplied numerical threshold.
The claim has no deadline and remains conditional.
criteria.support_condition: After the stated requirement is implemented, deployment evidence or a faithful adversarial trial establishes both substantial technical barriers and prohibitive costs for covertly controlling 10,000 qualifying accounts.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Under the stated enforced requirement, a documented operator or faithful adversarial trial sustains covert control of 10,000 qualifying accounts at low cost.
